title: The Fire That Should Have Killed Her

shots.visual_event: The archive projects Saira’s 1998 apartment fire from a punched railway card; sixteen-year-old Saira carries young Rohan through smoke.
A collapsing beam falls toward her, but a station clock inexplicably stops; Saira moves through the frozen second and survives.
One week later in the memory, the Midnight Train appears on a road with no tracks and takes Saira while Rohan sleeps.
shots.dialogue_audio: Saira: “It didn’t save me. It collected me.”

shots.visual_event: Inside the present train, Arin finds matching records: every passenger survived an impossible death before disappearing.
Arin’s own card shows a blurred figure pushing him away from the tracks 317 nights ago; the identity is deliberately obscured.
Nila appears behind the record glass and traces Meera’s turquoise hair clip in the blur.
